integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically by capacitated Hall and an explicit cyclic-cover obstruction. Finite computation is used only as a stress test.
limitations: The classification is specific to stars and ordinary equitable DP colorability; it does not classify SEDP colorability, double stars, or general trees. A residual literature risk remains for uncatalogued equivalent terminology.
title: Exact equitable DP-colorability spectrum of stars
